raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied rolling resistance physics, incorrectly asserting that sand has a lower rolling-resistance coefficient than a smooth hard surface and thus concluding the truck would roll faster on sand. In reality, sand greatly increases rolling resistance and energy losses, so the truck would roll slower. The premature "TASK_COMPLETE" decision cemented this incorrect conclusion without validation.
